voice.confirm.anthropic.text: The microphone button records through Claude Code, which sends your audio to Anthropic servers to transcribe it. Open chats restart once to turn it on. Claude Code sets the dictation language (/config). It uses no tokens, needs a claude.ai account, and does not work with ANTHROPIC_API_KEY or ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN set. Windows dictation (Win+H) needs no download.
voice.confirm.anthropic.title: Use Anthropic voice?
voice.confirm.local.text: Audio stays on this computer. The first dictation downloads whisper.cpp (8.9 MB) and the model you choose. Names and technical terms often come out wrong, so the text lands in the prompt for you to edit and is never sent by itself. Windows dictation (Win+H) needs no download.
